nodes.label: Dependabot 2-day cooldown vs pnpm minimumReleaseAge
nodes.rationale: pnpm refuses packages younger than 24h (ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION, seen on PR #176). Without a matching Dependabot cooldown, PRs open on packages too fresh and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` fails in CI until the package ages out; 2 days keeps a margin over pnpm's 24h window since the daily schedule drifts.

nodes.label: TypeScript >=7 pinned out of Dependabot
nodes.rationale: TypeScript 7.x crashes typescript-eslint whose peer dependency caps at <6.1.0 (PR #172); 6.x bumps keep flowing and the ignore is to be lifted once typescript-eslint supports TS 7.
